emittedMessages.text: Mapped adapter resolution returned no instance.

trigger.condition: Mapped Utility five-argument Invoke calls Resolve-MappedAdapter; its child Resolve-RegisteredAdapter is nonfailed but has no Result, so fixed no-instance log is emitted before media dispatch.

likelyCauses.text: Mapped Utility five-argument Invoke calls Resolve-MappedAdapter; its child Resolve-RegisteredAdapter is nonfailed but has no Result, so fixed no-instance log is emitted before media dispatch.

diagnostics.action: Inspect selected registration identity and child Failure/HasResult flags; redact slot/graph.
diagnostics.expected: Redacted flags identify this local guard without paths, file bytes, pixels, process output or effects.

correction.boundary: Diagnostic owner handoff only; no file, ImageMagick, media/provider effect, retry or trusted-bound change.

steps.action: Record registration owner handoff; stop before state repair or media invocation.
steps.expected: Owner handoff or conditional proposal recorded; guard clearance not claimed.

stopWhen: Canonical mapped/concrete identity, activity or exact message/pattern differs.
Effective Plan, trusted AdapterConfig, local file/effect state or owner cannot be established with redacted flags.
Proposed action would expose paths/bytes/pixels/tool output or run/retry media, alter trusted bounds or overwrite files.

entries.redaction: Exclude Plan/Config/Jacket/Signal/graph, local input/output/overlay paths, file bytes/hashes, pixels, command/diagnostics and exception text; retain canonical adapter/activity, exact message/pattern and nonsecret guard flags only.
limitations: Source-only confidence; no ImageMagick, file, media, provider or runtime execution.
A local guard, return Signal or Result does not establish effect state or safe replay.
